podcast.body: A single from the album of the same name, featuring a "great guitar solo" by Don Felder, which exemplified the band's move away from the "ballad syndrome" and towards a harder rock sound. "we wanted to get away from the ballad syndrome with one of these nights with Don Felder in the band now we can really rock he made us nastier and he did a great guitar solo on that single."

podcast.body: For the week ending August 30, 1975, this song was number four on the Billboard Top 10 chart. "4. One of these nights by the Eagles."

This song was the winner of the 1975 Billboard Song of the Summer. It features a "steamy groove" that "objectively sounds like a hot August night," which was the month it topped the Hot 100. "this 1975 song of the summer by Yes, The Eagles has a steamy groove that objectively sounds like a hot August night, appropriately that was the month when it topped the hot 100."
